turns.text: Which customers bought in every quarter of 2025 and have not bought at all in 2026?

{"sql": "
WITH q2025 AS (
  SELECT cust_id, CAST((CAST(strftime('%m', sold_on) AS INTEGER)+2)/3 AS INTEGER) AS q
  FROM pos_sales
  WHERE sold_on >= '2025-01-01' AND sold_on < '2026-01-01' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL
),
q_counts AS (
  SELECT cust_id, COUNT(DISTINCT q) AS qcount
  FROM q2025
  GROUP BY cust_id
),
all_4 AS (
  SELECT cust_id FROM q_counts WHERE qcount = 4
),
buy_2026 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM pos_sales WHERE sold_on >= '2026-01-01' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.cust_id, c.name, c.email
FROM all_4 a
LEFT JOIN buy_2026 b ON a.cust_id = b.cust_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.cust_id = c.cust_id
WHERE b.cust_id IS NULL
ORDER BY a.cust_id;
"}
